title: kbs create is quadratic in board size because of the duplicate-title check
description: find_duplicate_title (rust/src/issue_creation.rs:224) and _find_duplicate_title (python/src/kanbus/issue_creation.py:253) call read_issue_from_file per issue, and read_issue_from_file rebuilds a whole Virtuus table from the directory each call. At 320 issues one create opens issue files about 101,000 times: 1.8-2.5 s Rust, 9-12 s Python, versus 20 ms with --no-validate. Fix: read the directory once and compare titles in memory; make single-issue reads read one file. Keep unparseable-file behavior identical across implementations.
